Name: Tiberius Caesar
Summary: Tiberius Caesar was emperor when John the Baptist began preaching and when Jesus was crucified under Pontius Pilate. Luke dates the Baptist's ministry to the fifteenth year of his reign.
KeyStory: Luke dates the gospel to the fifteenth year of Tiberius, tying John's preaching to a real emperor's reign.
LifeLesson: The gospel happened under a named emperor in a numbered year. Faith here rests on history, not legend.
